behavior: AC1: no email or token in any .tf/tfvars file; state, plans, variable files, .terraform/ and crash logs are ignored
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_infra_terraform.py -k 'scanner or holds_an_email or ignored or tracked'

behavior: AC2: the token and the email reach Terraform in its environment, never on argv or in output; a missing secret stops before Terraform
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_infra_terraform.py -k 'environment_never_on_argv or missing_owner_email or wider_token'

behavior: AC3: infra-apply applies only the saved plan and refuses in CI
AC4: make check fails on Terraform that does not fmt/validate and only skips, with a notice, without Terraform
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_infra_terraform.py -k 'check_runs or check_skips or make_check_includes'

behavior: AC5: every managed resource has an import block; the Pages project cannot be destroyed and its deployment configuration is ignored
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_infra_terraform.py -k 'import_block or pages_project or access_ or audience or owner_email'

behavior: AC6: infra-ids refuses a token that cannot read Access and stops unless each object is found exactly once
AC7: the Pages project plans as 1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy (read-only, deploy token; owner command in the runbook)
verification: cd infra/terraform/cloudflare && CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN="$(sops -d --extract '["cloudflare_pages_token"]' ../../../data/private.sops.yaml)" TF_VAR_account_id=76967f5ede1ce50efce34d90b7e94958 TF_VAR_owner_email=unused TF_VAR_access_idp_id=unused TF_VAR_access_app_id=unused TF_VAR_access_policy_id=unused terraform plan -input=false -no-color -target=cloudflare_pages_project.site | grep -q 'Plan: 1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy'

behavior: AC8: runbooks name the targets, the manual leftovers and the decommission order
